name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.finiteExplorationExcess
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (d : ℕ),
  0 < d →
    ∀ (H : Fin d → Type u_2) [(a : Fin d) → Fintype (H a)] (h : (a : Fin d) → ℕ → Ω → H a) (X : Fin d → ℕ → Ω → ℕ)
      (B : Fin d → ℕ → Ω → Prop) (m : Fin d → ℕ) (γ b : ℝ),
      0 ≤ γ →
        1 ≤ b →
          (∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining (h a) (m a)) →
            (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : Ω), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X a i ω) (m a)) →
              (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : Ω), X a 0 ω = 0) →
                (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (X a i)) →
                  (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (B a i)) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin d),
                        ∀ i < m a,
                          ∀ (v : Ω),
                            B a i v →
                              (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => h a i ω = h a i v) →
                                (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => ↑(X a (m a) ω - X a i ω))
                                    fun (ω : Ω) => h a i ω = h a i v) ≤
                                  γ) →
                      ∀ (C : Ω → Prop),
                        (∀ (ω : Ω), C ω → ∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix (B a) (m a) ω) →
                          ∀ (Y : Ω → ℕ),
                            (∀ (ω : Ω), C ω → Y ω ≤ ∑ a : Fin d, X a (m a) ω) →
                              (b ^ d - 1) * γ < 1 →
                                (RiffleUpperV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => if C ω then b ^ Y ω - 1 else 0) ≤
                                  (b ^ d - 1) * γ / (1 - (b ^ d - 1) * γ)

                              (0 <
                                  RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                    fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                    h a i ω = h a i v) →

                                    (fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>

                                    fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>

name: RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.EndpointReveal.mk.noConfusion
type:
{k n d : ℕ} →
  {cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n d} →
    {c₀ : ℤ} →
      {R : Finset (Fin n)} →
        {x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k d} →
          {P : Sort u} →
            {History : Type} →
              {finiteHistory : Fintype History} →
                {history : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → History} →
                  {good : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop} →
                    {params : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.HypergeomParams} →
                      {shift : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → ℤ} →
                        {refines : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.Refines history (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x)} →
                          {good_measurable :
                              ∀ (ω₀ ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts), history ω = history ω₀ → (good ω ↔ good ω₀)} →
                            {shift_measurable :
                                ∀ (ω₀ ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts), history ω = history ω₀ → shift ω = shift ω₀} →
                              {endpoint_law :
                                  ∀ (ω₀ : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) (f : ℤ → ℝ),
                                    ((RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                          (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                            f (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.lowerEndpoint c₀ R x ω))
                                          fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => history ω = history ω₀) =
                                        RiffleUpperV2.expect (params ω₀).law.toPMF
                                          fun (q : Fin ((params ω₀).draws + 1)) => f (shift ω₀ + ↑↑q)) ∧
                                      (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                          (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                            f (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.upperEndpoint c₀ R x ω))
                                          fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => history ω = history ω₀) =
                                        RiffleUpperV2.expect (params ω₀).law.toPMF
                                          fun (q : Fin ((params ω₀).draws + 1)) =>
                                          f (shift ω₀ + ↑↑q + ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.prefixRows R x ω₀).card)} →
                                {History' : Type} →
                                  {finiteHistory' : Fintype History'} →
                                    {history' : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → History'} →
                                      {good' : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop} →
                                        {params' :
                                            RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.HypergeomParams} →
                                          {shift' : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → ℤ} →
                                            {refines' :
                                                RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.Refines history'
                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x)} →
                                              {good_measurable' :
                                                  ∀ (ω₀ ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                                    history' ω = history' ω₀ → (good' ω ↔ good' ω₀)} →
                                                {shift_measurable' :
                                                    ∀ (ω₀ ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                                      history' ω = history' ω₀ → shift' ω = shift' ω₀} →
                                                  {endpoint_law' :
                                                      ∀ (ω₀ : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) (f : ℤ → ℝ),
                                                        ((RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect
                                                              (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                              (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                                f (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.lowerEndpoint c₀ R x ω))
                                                              fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                              history' ω = history' ω₀) =
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.expect (params' ω₀).law.toPMF
                                                              fun (q : Fin ((params' ω₀).draws + 1)) =>
                                                              f (shift' ω₀ + ↑↑q)) ∧
                                                          (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect
                                                              (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                              (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                                f (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.upperEndpoint c₀ R x ω))
                                                              fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                              history' ω = history' ω₀) =
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.expect (params' ω₀).law.toPMF
                                                              fun (q : Fin ((params' ω₀).draws + 1)) =>
                                                              f
                                                                (shift' ω₀ + ↑↑q +
                                                                  ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.prefixRows R x ω₀).card)} →
                                                    { History := History, finiteHistory := finiteHistory,
                                                          history := history, good := good, params := params,
                                                          shift := shift, refines := refines,
                                                          good_measurable := good_measurable,
                                                          shift_measurable := shift_measurable,
                                                          endpoint_law := endpoint_law } =
                                                        { History := History', finiteHistory := finiteHistory',
                                                          history := history', good := good', params := params',
                                                          shift := shift', refines := refines',
                                                          good_measurable := good_measurable',
                                                          shift_measurable := shift_measurable',
                                                          endpoint_law := endpoint_law' } →
                                                      (History = History' →
                                                          finiteHistory ≍ finiteHistory' →
                                                            history ≍ history' →
                                                              good ≍ good' → params ≍ params' → shift ≍ shift' → P) →
                                                        P

type:

  (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts 0) (T C chi delta width : ℝ) (hchi : 0 < chi) (hchi1 : chi ≤ 1)
  (hchiK : chi ≤ 1 / ↑k) (hwidth : 0 < width) (hd : ↑d ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀
      (s :
        RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.RetainedAtPile hk N (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
          (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi delta hchiK),
      chi < 1 →
        ∀ (a₀ : ℕ) {eta g : ℝ},
          RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N a₀ cuts hn eta →
            0 < g →
              g < 1 →
                RiffleUpperV2.FirstColumnGood cuts hn g →
                  0 ≤ delta →
                    (RiffleUpperV2.Localization.crossingPenalty N chi - eta) / 2 < delta →
                      ¬RiffleUpperV2.Localization.TerminalBoundaryPair (↑s.snd).1 (↑s.snd).2.1 →
                        ∀ (c₀ : ℤ) (slots : Finset ℤ),
                          ↑(RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.classPrefixes hk hN (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts)
                                    hn (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) T C chi delta
                                    width hchi hchi1 hchiK hwidth hd s).card *
                              RiffleUpperV2.Localization.anchoredDensity (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) c₀
                                ((fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) s.fst)
                                ((fun
                                      (t :
                                        RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.RetainedAtPile hk N
                                          (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                          (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi delta
                                          hchiK) =>
                                    (↑t.snd).2.2)
                                  s)
                                slots ≤
                            4 *
                                  √(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.varianceDenominator chi
                                        ((fun
                                              (t :
                                                RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.RetainedAtPile hk N
                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                                  (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi
                                                  delta hchiK) =>
                                            RiffleUpperV2.Localization.boundaryJoin (↑t.snd).1 (↑t.snd).2.1)
                                          s) /
                                      g) *
                                ↑N ^
                                  (-eta + delta + RiffleUpperV2.Localization.crossingPenalty N chi / 2 +
                                    (4 * width + 4 * Real.log ↑k * TimeProfile.exceptionalAllowance chi)) +
                              ↑(RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.classPrefixes hk hN
                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                      (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) T C chi delta
                                      width hchi hchi1 hchiK hwidth hd s).card *
                                (6 * ↑slots.card *
                                  Real.exp
                                    (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * g *
                                      RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.sideScale (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts)
                                        ((fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) s.fst)
                                        ((fun
                                              (t :
                                                RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.RetainedAtPile hk N
                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                                  (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi
                                                  delta hchiK) =>
                                            RiffleUpperV2.Localization.boundaryJoin (↑t.snd).1 (↑t.snd).2.1)
                                          s)))

                    ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                      1 ≤ N0 ∧
                        ∀ (n : ℕ),
                          N0 ≤ n →
                            ∀ (L : ℕ),
                              ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑n →
                                ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n),
                                  TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn 0) g →
                                    ∀ (ξ : ℝ) (p : Fin k) (e : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) ↪ Fin n)
                                      (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                      (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g
                                          RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward
                                          (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.backwardWords cuts p ω j) →
                                        ∀ (A : Finset (Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)))
                                          (a :

                                              RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                          (Finset.univ \ A).card = 1 ∨ (Finset.univ \ A).card = 2 →
                                            ∀ (ω₀ : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                              RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileBase cuts p e A a ω₀ →
                                                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.concentrationEvent cuts D g ξ ω₀ →
                                                  ∀ (E : ℕ) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min E L))
                                                    (Target : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop),
                                                    (∀ (z : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                                        RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileBase cuts p e A a z →
                                                          Target z →
                                                            ∀ q ∉ A,
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailPrefix E
                                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleWords e z q) =
                                                                v) →
                                                      (∀ (z : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                                          RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileBase cuts p e A a z →
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p
                                                                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward (↑j + 1) ω
                                                                z →
                                                              Target z →
                                                                RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.backwardUnmarkedHistoryConstraint
                                                                  cuts p ω j A a) →
                                                        (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability
                                                            (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) Target
                                                            fun (z : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileBase cuts p e A a z ∧
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p
                                                                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward (↑j + 1) ω
                                                                z) ≤
                                                          2 ^ (Finset.univ \ A).card *
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailMass cuts E v ^
                                                                (↑(Finset.univ \ A).card *
                                                                  (1 - Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ))) /

                      (∀ x ∈ W, RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.IsPrefix v x) →

                            ∀ j ∈ I,

                                TimeProfile.prob (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn j)
                                  (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default x j)) →
                          (∀ x ∈ W,
                              RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.exceptionalPositions (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn) I chi
                                  (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default x) =
                                RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.exceptionalPositions (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn) I chi
                                  (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default w0)) →

                                  j ∈
                                    RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.exceptionalPositions (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn) I
                                      chi (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default w0),
                                  RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default x j =
                                    RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default w0 j) →
                              (∀ x ∈ W,
                                  ⌊RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.goodCost N (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn) I chi
                                          (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default x) /
                                        width⌋₊ =

                                          (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default w0) /

                                          chi (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default w0)).card ≤

                                    theta *
                                          RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.goodCost N (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn) I chi
                                            (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default w0) -

type:

      RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts ⋯ ≤ ↑N ^ (-η) →
        A + 1 ≤ η * ↑bound →
          ∀ (d : ℕ),
            0 < d →
              ∀ (H : Fin d → Type u_1) [(a : Fin d) → Fintype (H a)]
                (h : (a : Fin d) → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → H a)
                (X : Fin d → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → ℕ)

                0 ≤ γ →
                  (∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining (h a) (m a)) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                        RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X a i ω) (m a)) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts), X a 0 ω = 0) →
                        (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (X a i)) →
                          (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (B a i)) →
                            (∀ (a : Fin d),
                                ∀ i < m a,
                                  ∀ (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                    B a i v →
                                      (0 <
                                          RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                            fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                            h a i ω = h a i v) →
                                        (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                            (fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                              ↑(X a (m a) ω - X a i ω))
                                            fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                            h a i ω = h a i v) ≤
                                          γ) →
                              (∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                  RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.regularTruncation cuts R bound ω.1 ∧
                                      RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.regularTruncation cuts R bound ω.2 →
                                    ∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix (B a) (m a) ω) →
                                (∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),

                                        RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.regularTruncation cuts R bound ω.2 →
                                      Finset.card (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω.1 ∩ RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω.2) ≤
                                        ∑ a : Fin d, X a (m a) ω) →
                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant bound ^ d - 1) * γ ≤ 1 / 2 →
                                    RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts)
                                        (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
                                      (√(2 * (RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant bound ^ d - 1) * γ) / 2 +

                    ∃ (C1 : ℝ),
                      0 < C1 ∧
                        ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                          1 ≤ N0 ∧
                            ∀ (n : ℕ),
                              N0 ≤ n →
                                ∀ (L : ℕ),
                                  ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑n →
                                    ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n),
                                      TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn 0) g →
                                        ∀ (ξ ε : ℝ),
                                          0 ≤ ε →
                                            ∀ (p : Fin k) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                              (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p
                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward (↑j + 1) ω →

                                                    RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward (↑j + 1) ω →
                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g
                                                      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward
                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileWords cuts p ω j) →
                                                    ∀ (E : ℕ) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min E L)),

                                                        RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect
                                                            (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                            (fun (z : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                              ↑(RiffleUpperV2.prefixCount
                                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix E p v) z))
                                                            (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward (↑j + 1) ω) ≤
                                                          C1 * ↑n *
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.prefixMass cuts
                                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix E p v) ^

          ∑ w : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1),

                ¬RiffleUpperV2.Localization.TerminalBoundaryPair (↑s.snd).1 (↑s.snd).2.1 →

                                (t :

                                    (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                    (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi delta
                                    hchiK) =>

                                  ↑(RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.classPrefixes hk hN
                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                        (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) T C chi delta
                                        width hchi hchi1 hchiK hwidth hd t).card /
                                TimeProfile.logScale N)
                            s +

                            (fun
                                  (t :
                                    RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.RetainedAtPile hk N
                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                      (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi delta
                                      hchiK) =>
                                RiffleUpperV2.Localization.meanExponent N (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts)
                                  ((fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) t.fst)
                                  ((fun
                                        (t :
                                          RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.RetainedAtPile hk N
                                            (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                            (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi delta
                                            hchiK) =>

                              s -

                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                  (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi delta hchiK) =>

                              ((fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) t.fst)
                              ((fun
                                    (t :

                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                        (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi delta
                                        hchiK) =>
                                  RiffleUpperV2.Localization.boundaryJoin (↑t.snd).1 (↑t.snd).2.1)
                                t))
                          s -
                      2 *
                        RiffleUpperV2.empiricalB N a₀ cuts hn 2
                          (a₀ + 1 +
                            ↑((fun
                                      (t :
                                        RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.RetainedAtPile hk N
                                          (RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.tailCuts cuts) hn
                                          (fun (a : Fin k) => RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.anchorRows c a) C chi delta

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.adaptedExcess
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [Fintype H] (P : PMF Ω) (h : ℕ → Ω → H) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℕ)
  (B : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ),
  0 ≤ γ →
    RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining h m →
      (∀ (ω : Ω), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X i ω) m) →
        (∀ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω = 0) →
          (∀ i ≤ m, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h i) (X i)) →
            (∀ i ≤ m, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h i) (B i)) →
              (∀ i < m,
                  ∀ (a : Ω),
                    B i a →
                      (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => h i ω = h i a) →
                        (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => ↑(X m ω - X i ω)) fun (ω : Ω) =>
                            h i ω = h i a) ≤
                          γ) →
                ∀ (C : Ω → Prop),
                  (∀ (ω : Ω), C ω → RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix B m ω) →
                    ∀ (t : ℝ),

                                          (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.pileWords cuts p ω j) →

type:

      ∀ (d : ℕ),

            (h : (a : Fin d) → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → H a)

            (B : Fin d → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop) (m : Fin d → ℕ) (γ : ℝ),
            0 ≤ γ →
              (∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining (h a) (m a)) →
                (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                    RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X a i ω) (m a)) →
                  (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts), X a 0 ω = 0) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (X a i)) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (B a i)) →
                        (∀ (a : Fin d),
                            ∀ i < m a,
                              ∀ (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                B a i v →
                                  (0 <
                                      RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                        fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                        h a i ω = h a i v) →
                                    (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                        (fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                          ↑(X a (m a) ω - X a i ω))
                                        fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                        h a i ω = h a i v) ≤
                                      γ) →
                          (∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                              S1 ω.1 ∧ S1 ω.2 → ∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix (B a) (m a) ω) →

                                S1 ω.1 ∧ S1 ω.2 →
                                  Finset.card (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω.1 ∩ RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω.2) ≤
                                    ∑ a : Fin d, X a (m a) ω) →
                              (RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant bound ^ d - 1) * γ < 1 →
                                RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts)
                                    (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
                                  √((RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant bound ^ d - 1) * γ /

name: RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.conditionalSamplingTransport
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (V R A B : Finset α) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ V.card),
  R ⊆ V →
    ∀ (hA : A ⊆ V \ R),
      (0 <
          RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw V m hm).toPMF
            fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => ↑S ∩ R = B) →
        ∃ (hres : m - B.card ≤ (V \ R).card),
          (∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ),
              (RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw V m hm).toPMF
                  (fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => f (A ∩ ↑S).card)
                  fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => ↑S ∩ R = B) =
                RiffleLowerV2.expect
                  (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.samplingParams (V \ R) A (m - B.card) hA hres).law.toPMF
                  fun
                    (x :
                      Fin ((RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.samplingParams (V \ R) A (m - B.card) hA hres).draws + 1)) =>
                  f ↑x) ∧
            ∀ (E : ℕ → Prop),
              (RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw V m hm).toPMF
                  (fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => E (A ∩ ↑S).card)
                  fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => ↑S ∩ R = B) =
                RiffleLowerV2.probability
                  (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.samplingParams (V \ R) A (m - B.card) hA hres).law.toPMF
                  fun
                    (x :
                      Fin ((RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.samplingParams (V \ R) A (m - B.card) hA hres).draws + 1)) =>
                  E ↑x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.integerWindow_cluster
type:
∀ {k n L N : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n) {ρ γ g : ℝ},
  0 ≤ ρ →
    0 < γ →
      γ ≤ 1 →
        1 ≤ N →
          8 < γ * (ρ * Real.log ↑N) →
            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.integerWindowGood N cuts hn ρ γ g →
              ∀ (b : ℕ),
                b + RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ ≤ L + 1 →
                  ∃ (a : Fin (L + 1)) (j : Fin (L + 1)) (c : Fin (L + 1)),
                    b ≤ ↑a ∧
                      ↑c < b + RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ ∧
                        a < j ∧
                          j < c ∧
                            ↑c - ↑a ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.clusterSpan γ ∧
                              TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn a) g ∧
                                TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn j) g ∧
                                  TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn c) g
